# 0. Reset Memory and Re-import libraries

```{r R setup, eval=FALSE,warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# 데이터를 모두 해제합니다.
#rm(list=ls())

library("reticulate")
library("dplyr")
library("tidyr")
library("ggplot2")
library("tidytext")
library("stm")
library("tm")
library("pheatmap")
library("factoextra")
library("wordcloud")
library("rstudioapi")
library("jsonlite")

pymod<-import("modules")
# Plot export helpers
dataset_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename("data/processed11.csv"))
plot_output_dir <- file.path("output", dataset_name)
dir.create(plot_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

plot_tracker <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
plot_tracker$count <- 0

sanitize_label <- function(label) {
  label <- gsub("[^0-9A-Za-z가-힣_\\-]+", "_", label)
  label <- gsub("_+", "_", label)
  label <- sub("^_+", "", label)
  label <- sub("_+$", "", label)
  if (label == "") label <- "plot"
  label
}

save_plot <- function(label = "plot") {
  if (is.null(dev.list())) {
    message(sprintf("No active plot to save for label '%s'", label))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  last_plot <- recordPlot()
  plot_tracker$count <- plot_tracker$count + 1
  filename <- sprintf("%02d_%s.png", plot_tracker$count, sanitize_label(label))
  filepath <- file.path(plot_output_dir, filename)
  png(filename = filepath, width = 1600, height = 1200, res = 180)
  replayPlot(last_plot)
  dev.off()
  message(sprintf("Saved plot: %s", filepath))
}
```

# 1. Import dataset

```{r eval=FALSE}

list.files(path="data")

CURRENT_DIR <- dirname(getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

pat_raw <- read.csv(
  paste0("data/",dataset_name,".csv"),
  fileEncoding     = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# 2. Preprocess VIA Python

이 청크에서 파이썬의 사전 정의된 모듈을 Import하고, 데이터프레임으로 전처리합니다.

```{r echo=FALSE}
pat_preprocessed <- pat_raw %>%
  rename(
    id             = applicationNumber,
    title          = inventionTitle,
    abstract       = abstractContent,
    #year           = applicationDate,
    #org_name       = applicantName,
  ) %>% 
  pymod$preprocess_df(tagger_type="okt",title_weight=3L,abstract_weight=1L)
  
corpus <- Corpus(pat_preprocessed$processed_text %>% VectorSource)
# build corpus
print("PREPROCESSING COMPLETE")
```

## 2.a. Merge with metadata

```{r echo=FALSE}

metadata_list <- fromJSON(paste0("data/",dataset_name,"_metadata.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)

app_ids <- pat_raw$applicationNumber %>% as.character
match_indices <- match(app_ids, names(metadata_list)) %>% as.numeric

extract_field <- function(idx, field) {
  entry <- metadata_list[[idx]]
  entry[[field]]
}

# Primary applicant (first in list)
pat_preprocessed$applicantName <- match_indices %>% 
  sapply(\(x){extract_field(x,"applicantName")[[1]] %>% as.character})

# All applicants (semicolon-separated)
pat_preprocessed$applicantName_all <- match_indices %>%
  sapply(\(x){extract_field(x,"applicantName") %>% paste(collapse=";")})

# Application date (convert YYYYMMDD -> Date)
pat_preprocessed$applicationDate <-match_indices %>% 
  sapply(\(x){extract_field(x,"applicationDate")}) %>% as.Date(format="%Y%m%d")

top_applicants <- pat_preprocessed$applicantName %>%
  table() %>%
  sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
  names() %>%
  head(10)

#ifelse(applicantName %in% top_applicants, applicantName, "Other")
pat <- pat_preprocessed %>% mutate(
  applicantGroup = orgType %>% factor %>% relevel(ref="individual"),
  applicationYear = as.integer(format(applicationDate, "%Y")),
)
head(pat[, c("id", "applicantName")], 5)
```

# 4. Search for optimum K

```{r eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=True}

candidates <- seq(from=8, to=24, by=2)

kresult <- searchK(
  documents = docs,
  vocab = vocab,
  data = meta,
  K = candidates,
  seed = 42,
)

plot(kresult)
save_plot("searchK")
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
K_final <- 14
```

# 5. Fit STM model

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, paged.print=TRUE}
set.seed(42)

stm_model <- stm(
  documents = docs,
  vocab = vocab,
  K = K_final,
  prevalence = ~ applicantGroup * applicationYear,
  data = meta,
  max.em.its = 10000,
  init.type = "Spectral",
  verbose=TRUE,
  reportevery=5,
  gamma.prior = 'L1'
)
```

## 6.1.1. Topic Share Summary Export

```{r Topic Share Summary, echo=FALSE}
if (exists("stm_model")) {
  topic_props <- colMeans(stm_model$theta)
  topic_pct <- round(topic_props * 100, 3)

  frex_matrix <- labelTopics(stm_model)$frex
  frex_labels <- apply(frex_matrix, 1, paste, collapse = ", ")

  topic_share_df <- data.frame(
    Topic = seq_along(topic_props),
    Share_Pct = topic_pct,
    FREX = frex_labels
  )

  print(topic_share_df)

  topic_share_csv <- file.path(plot_output_dir, "topic_share_summary.csv")
  write.csv(topic_share_df, topic_share_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  message(sprintf("Saved topic share summary: %s", topic_share_csv))
} else {
  message("STM model not available; skipping topic share export.")
}
```

## 6.5. Applicant-Year Interaction Effect

```{r Applicant Year Interaction, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
if (exists("stm_model")) {
  effect_model <- estimateEffect(
    1:K_final ~ applicantGroup * applicationYear,
    stmobj = stm_model,
    metadata = meta,
    uncertainty = "Global"
  )

  topics_to_plot <- seq_len(K_final)
  target_applicants <- levels(pat$applicantGroup) %>% unique()
  #  intersect(
  #  levels(pat$applicantGroup),
  #  c(top_applicants, "Other")
  #) %>% unique()
  #%>% head(3)

  if (length(target_applicants) == 0) {
    message("No applicant groups available for interaction plot.")
  } else {
    for (app in target_applicants) {
      plot(
        effect_model,
        covariate = "applicationYear",
        method = "continuous",
        moderator = "applicantGroup",
        moderator.value = app,
        topics = topics_to_plot,
        xlab = "Application Year",
        ylab = "Expected Topic Prevalence",
        main = paste("Applicant-Year Effect:", app),
        printlegend = TRUE,
        lwd = 3
      )
      #save_plot(paste0("interaction_", app))
    }
  }
} else {
  message("STM model not available; skipping interaction plot.")
}
```

## 6.6. STM Prevalence Coefficients by Topic

```{r STM Prevalence Coefficients, echo=FALSE}
if (exists("stm_model") && exists("effect_model")) {
  effect_summary <- summary(effect_model)

  all_coef_list <- list()
  for (topic_idx in seq_along(effect_summary$tables)) {
    coef_table <- effect_summary$tables[[topic_idx]]
    coef_df <- data.frame(
      Topic = topic_idx,
      Term = rownames(coef_table),
      Estimate = coef_table[, "Estimate"],
      StdError = coef_table[, "Std. Error"],
      tValue = coef_table[, "t value"],
      pValue = coef_table[, "Pr(>|t|)"],
      row.names = NULL
    )
    all_coef_list[[topic_idx]] <- coef_df
    print(coef_df)
  }

  all_coef_df <- do.call(rbind, all_coef_list)
  coef_csv_path <- file.path(plot_output_dir, "stm_prevalence_coefficients.csv")
  write.csv(all_coef_df, coef_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
  message(sprintf("Saved coefficients: %s", coef_csv_path))
} else {
  message("STM model or effect_model not available; skipping coefficient display.")
}
```

# 7. Build Wordclouds

## 7.1. Topic Wordclouds

```{r echo=FALSE}

beta_mat <- exp(stm_model$beta$logbeta[[1]])

if (!exists("K_final")) {
  K_final <- stm_model$settings$dim$K
}

vocab_clean <- sapply(strsplit(stm_model$vocab, "/"), \(x) x[1])

for (k in 1:K_final) {
  topic_beta <- beta_mat[k, ]

  ord <- order(topic_beta, decreasing = TRUE)

  top_n <- 30
  top_idx <- ord[1:top_n]
  
  words_k <- vocab_clean[top_idx]
  freq_k  <- topic_beta[top_idx]
  
  # 워드클라우드
  wordcloud(
    words = words_k,
    freq = freq_k,
    max.words = top_n,
    scale = c(2, 0.6),
    random.order = FALSE,
  )
  
  title(paste("Topic", k, "Wordcloud"))
  save_plot(sprintf("topic_wordcloud_%02d", k))
}
```

# 8. Top Applicants by Topic Analysis

```{r Top Applicants Topic Analysis, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Get topic assignments for each document
gamma_df <- stm_model$theta %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(doc_id = row_number())

# Find dominant topic for each document
topic_assignments <- gamma_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -doc_id, names_to = "topic", values_to = "gamma") %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  slice_max(gamma, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(topic = gsub("V", "Topic ", topic))

# Merge with metadata to get applicant information
if (exists("pat") && "applicantName" %in% names(pat)) {
  doc_topic_applicant <- pat %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(topic_assignments, by = "doc_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(applicantName))  # Remove rows with missing applicant names
  
  # Find top applicants
  top_applicants <- doc_topic_applicant %>%
    count(applicantName, sort = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    pull(applicantName)
  
  # Analyze topic distribution for top applicants
  applicant_topic_summary <- doc_topic_applicant %>%
    filter(applicantName %in% top_applicants) %>%
    count(applicantName, topic) %>%
    group_by(applicantName) %>%
    mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Create visualization
  top_applicants_plot <- ggplot(
    applicant_topic_summary,
    aes(x = reorder(applicantName, -n, sum), y = n, fill = topic)
  ) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Top Applicants by Topic Distribution",
      x = "Applicant Name",
      y = "Number of Patents",
      fill = "Topic"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  print(top_applicants_plot)
  save_plot("top_applicants_topic_distribution")
  
  # Print summary table
  summary_table <- applicant_topic_summary %>%
    group_by(applicantName) %>%
    summarise(total_patents = sum(n)) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_patents))

  print("Top 10 Most Active Applicants:")
  print(summary_table)
} else {
  print("Warning: applicantName column not found in pat")
  print("Available columns:")
  if (exists("pat")) {
    print(names(pat))
  }
}
```

# 9. Applicant Topic Profiles

## 9.1. Top Patents per Topic

```{r Topic Patent Listings, echo=FALSE}
if (exists("stm_model") && exists("pat")) {
  top_n_docs <- 3L

  topic_label_matrix <- labelTopics(stm_model, n = 3)$frex
  topic_titles <- apply(topic_label_matrix, 1, paste, collapse = ", ")

  doc_meta <- pat %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    select(doc_id, Title = title)

  topic_doc_map <- stm_model$theta %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-doc_id, names_to = "topic", values_to = "gamma") %>%
    mutate(topic_num = gsub("[^0-9]", "", topic) %>% as.integer()) %>%
    group_by(topic_num) %>%
    arrange(desc(gamma)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n_docs) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(doc_meta, by = "doc_id")

  if (nrow(topic_doc_map) == 0) {
    message("No topic assignments available for listing")
  } else {
    for (topic_id in sort(unique(topic_doc_map$topic_num))) {
      topic_df <- topic_doc_map %>%
        filter(topic_num == topic_id)

      topic_heading <- paste0(
        "Topic ", topic_id,
        if (!is.null(topic_titles) && topic_id <= length(topic_titles))
          paste0(" (", topic_titles[topic_id], ")")
        else
          ""
      )

      cat(sprintf("#### %s\n", topic_heading))
      titles <- topic_df$Title
      if (length(titles) == 0) {
        cat("(No documents found)\n\n")
      } else {
        for (idx in seq_along(titles)) {
          cat(sprintf("%d. %s\n", idx, titles[[idx]]))
        }
        cat("\n")
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  message("Required data (pat, stm_model) not available.")
}
```

```{r Applicant Topic Profiles, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
if (exists("pat") && exists("stm_model")) {
  # Long format for topic assignment
  topic_long <- stm_model$theta %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-doc_id, names_to = "topic", values_to = "gamma")

  dominant_topic <- topic_long %>%
    group_by(doc_id) %>%
    slice_max(gamma, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  doc_topic_applicant <- pat %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(dominant_topic, by = "doc_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(applicantName), !is.na(topic))

  top_applicants <- doc_topic_applicant %>%
    count(applicantName, sort = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10) %>%
    pull(applicantName)

  plot_data <- doc_topic_applicant %>%
    filter(applicantName %in% top_applicants) %>%
    count(applicantName, topic)

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    message("No topic data available for selected applicants")
  } else {
    topic_levels <- plot_data$topic %>% unique() %>% sort()
    heatmap_matrix <- plot_data %>%
      mutate(
        applicantName = factor(applicantName, levels = top_applicants),
        topic = factor(topic, levels = topic_levels)
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = applicantName, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
      arrange(topic)

    hm_topics <- heatmap_matrix$topic %>% as.character()
    hm_mat <- heatmap_matrix %>%
      select(-topic) %>%
      as.matrix()
    rownames(hm_mat) <- hm_topics

    pheatmap(
      hm_mat,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      display_numbers = TRUE,
      number_format = "%d",
      main = "출원인별 등록 특허 수",
      angle_col="315"
    )
    save_plot("applicant_topic_heatmap")

    corp_plot_data <- doc_topic_applicant %>%
      filter(orgType == "firm", applicantName %in% top_applicants) %>%
      count(applicantName, topic)

    if (nrow(corp_plot_data) > 0) {
      corp_topics <- corp_plot_data$topic %>% unique() %>% sort()
      corp_heatmap <- corp_plot_data %>%
        mutate(
          applicantName = factor(applicantName, levels = top_applicants[top_applicants %in% applicantName]),
          topic = factor(topic, levels = corp_topics)
        ) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = applicantName, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
        arrange(topic)

      corp_topic_labels <- corp_heatmap$topic %>% as.character()
      corp_mat <- corp_heatmap %>% select(-topic) %>% as.matrix()
      rownames(corp_mat) <- corp_topic_labels

      pheatmap(
        corp_mat,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        display_numbers = TRUE,
        number_format = "%d",
        main = "기업별 등록 특허 수",
        angle_col = "315"
      )
      save_plot("applicant_topic_heatmap_corp")
    } else {
      message("No 기업 applicants available for heatmap")
    }

    for (applicant in top_applicants) {
      applicant_df <- plot_data %>% filter(applicantName == applicant)
      if (nrow(applicant_df) == 0) next

      applicant_plot <- ggplot(applicant_df, aes(x = topic, y = n, fill = topic)) +
        geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
        labs(
          title = paste("토픽 분포:", applicant),
          x = "Topic",
          y = "Patent Count"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

      print(applicant_plot)
      save_plot(paste0("topic_profile_", applicant))
    }
  }
} else {
  message("Required data (pat, stm_model) not available.")
}
```

# 10. Topic Volume by Application Year

## 10.1. Overall Topic Share Radar Chart

```{r Overall Topic Radar, echo=FALSE, fig.height=6}
if (exists("stm_model") && exists("stm_hc")) {
  ordered_indices <- stm_hc$order

  topic_labels <- paste0("T", 1:K_final)

  topic_props <- colMeans(stm_model$theta)

  overall_radar_df <- data.frame(
    orgType = "Overall",
    Topic_ID = paste0("Topic ", seq_along(topic_props)),
    Proportion = topic_props,
    Label = topic_labels,
    Order = match(seq_along(topic_props), ordered_indices)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Order)) %>%
    arrange(Order)

  overall_radar_path <- file.path(plot_output_dir, "overall_topic_radar.png")
  pymod$radar_chart(overall_radar_df, overall_radar_path)
} else {
  message("STM model or stm_hc not available; skipping overall radar chart.")
}
```

```{r Topic Volume by Year, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
if (exists("stm_model")) {
  year_meta <- meta %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    select(doc_id, applicationYear)

  topic_long <- stm_model$theta %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(-doc_id, names_to = "topic", values_to = "gamma")

  dominant_topic <- topic_long %>%
    group_by(doc_id) %>%
    slice_max(gamma, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(topic = gsub("V", "Topic ", topic))

  topic_year_df <- dominant_topic %>%
    left_join(year_meta, by = "doc_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(applicationYear)) %>%
    count(applicationYear, topic) %>%
    group_by(applicationYear) %>%
    mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(topic_year_df) == 0) {
    message("No application year information available for plotting")
  } else {
    topic_year_plot <- ggplot(topic_year_df, aes(x = applicationYear, y = pct, color = topic)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "Topic Share by Application Year",
      x = "Application Year",
      y = "Topic Share (%)",
      color = "Topic"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
    
    print(topic_year_plot)
    save_plot("topic_share_by_year")
    
    year_cols <- topic_year_df$applicationYear %>% unique() %>% sort() %>% as.character()

    topic_year_pivot <- topic_year_df %>%
      mutate(applicationYear = as.character(applicationYear)) %>%
      select(-n) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = applicationYear, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0) %>%
      mutate(topic = factor(topic, levels = sort(unique(topic)))) %>%
      arrange(topic)

    topic_year_mat <- topic_year_pivot %>%
      select(topic, all_of(year_cols))

    topic_labels <- topic_year_mat$topic %>% as.character()
    topic_year_mat <- topic_year_mat %>%
      select(-topic) %>%
      as.matrix()
    rownames(topic_year_mat) <- topic_labels

    pheatmap(
      topic_year_mat,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      angle_col = 45,
      display_numbers = TRUE,
      number_format="%.1f",
      main = "등록년별 토픽 비율 (%)"
    )
    save_plot("topic_share_by_year_heatmap")
  }
} else {
  message("STM model not available; skipping topic-by-year plot.")
}
```

# 11. Plot Radar-chart via Python and export.

```{r fig.height=6}
# [R Code] 파이썬으로 보낼 데이터 준비 (유사도 정렬)

# 1. 덴드로그램 순서 가져오기 (이미 hc가 있다고 가정)
# hc <- hclust(dist(scale(model_20$beta$logbeta[[1]])), method="ward.D2")
ordered_indices <- stm_hc$order  # 유사한 것끼리 뭉친 순서

# 2. 토픽 라벨 준비
labels <- labelTopics(stm_model, n = 3)$frex
topic_labels <- apply(labels, 1, paste, collapse = "/")
topic_labels <- paste0("T", 1:K_final)

# 3. orgType별 토픽 비중 계산
theta_df <- stm_model$theta %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(doc_id = row_number())

  org_meta <- meta %>%
    mutate(doc_id = row_number()) %>%
    select(doc_id, orgType)
  
  theta_by_org <- theta_df %>%
    left_join(org_meta, by = "doc_id") %>%
    filter(!is.na(orgType)) %>%
    group_by(orgType) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("V"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

if (nrow(theta_by_org) == 0) {
  message("orgType 정보가 없어 레이더 차트를 건너뜁니다.")
} else {
  org_targets <- org_meta %>%
    count(orgType, sort = TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(orgType)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 4) %>%
    pull(orgType)

  if (length(org_targets) == 0) {
    message("유효한 orgType이 없어 레이더 차트를 건너뜁니다.")
  } else {
    theta_by_org <- theta_by_org %>%
      filter(orgType %in% org_targets)

    topic_cols <- theta_by_org %>%
      select(starts_with("V")) %>%
      colnames()

    topic_long <- theta_by_org %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = all_of(topic_cols), names_to = "topic_col", values_to = "Proportion") %>%
      mutate(
        Topic_Index = gsub("[^0-9]", "", topic_col) %>% as.integer(),
        Topic_ID = paste0("Topic ", Topic_Index),
        Label = topic_labels[Topic_Index],
        Order = match(Topic_Index, ordered_indices)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Order)) %>%
      arrange(factor(orgType, levels = org_targets), Order)

    df_radar <- topic_long %>%
      select(orgType, Topic_ID, Proportion, Label, Order)
    df_radar$orgType <- as.character(df_radar$orgType)

    radar_plot_path <- file.path(plot_output_dir, "topic_radar_chart.png")
    pymod$radar_chart(df_radar, radar_plot_path)
  }
}
# 4. 저장

#cat("레이더 차트용 데이터 저장 완료!")
```
